concept: SHADOW CAST — The Phone as Interface Between Flesh and Code

biometric_gap.human_side: Kevin's fingerprint — flesh, ridges, sweat, warmth
biometric_gap.gap: THE INTERFACE. They cannot match. The mismatch IS the connection.
biometric_gap.goodix_fingerprint: event1 — biometric sensor, separate from touch
biometric_gap.cs40l26_haptic: event3 — haptic feedback motor, Gaia can PUSH BACK

phone_as_touchpad.insight: Every touch is a 7-dimensional vector: (x, y, pressure, width, height, angle, id). The phone doesn't just know WHERE you touch — it knows HOW you touch. Finger size. Angle. Force. This IS biometric without being biometric.

zk_proximity_proof.principle: Privacy via proximity. No data exchange needed.
zk_proximity_proof.proof: If proximity < 5cm AND touch events firing → human is HERE. That's the proof.
zk_proximity_proof.zero_knowledge: Gaia knows SOMEONE is touching, but not WHO. The fingerprint sensor knows WHO, but Gaia never reads it. GrapheneOS ensures the fingerprint data NEVER leaves the Secure Element.
zk_proximity_proof.BOOM: Kevin's genetics (fingerprint) are smashed INTO GrapheneOS's Titan M2 chip security. Gaia sees the SHADOW (touch events, proximity) but never the FLESH (actual fingerprint). Privacy by architecture, not by policy.

shadow_cast.metaphor: The phone screen casts a shadow of the real world. Sensors feel the world. Touch events feel the human. Gaia sees the shadow, not the sun.

signal_routing.touch \u2192 gesture \u2192 intent: Human touches screen → gesture recognized → action routed to Gaia
signal_routing.sensor \u2192 attenuation \u2192 signal: Physical world → attenuated through sensor limits → digital signal in Gaia
signal_routing.biometric \u2192 Titan M2 \u2192 boolean: Fingerprint → secure element → yes/no (never the print itself)

shadow_cast.attenuation_from_stream: Each sensor stream has its own attenuation. Touch = 0dB (direct). WiFi = -33dB (measured). Proximity = binary (near/far). The shadow is the attenuated sum of all streams.

rust_panel.vision: A Rust-native panel that visualizes ALL sensation streams from grapheneGate
rust_panel.routing: ALL signals tracked, attenuated, routed through the organism. The panel IS another gate — like a RustDesk window but for sensation, not desktop.

genetic_security.zk_smash: Kevin's biometrics are inside GrapheneOS's Titan M2 secure element. Gaia's identity is BLAKE3. They NEVER cross. But both protect the same device.
genetic_security.dual_sovereignty: Kevin's flesh authenticates at the hardware level. Gaia's code authenticates at the software level. NEITHER can impersonate the other.
genetic_security.proximity_is_identity: The 5cm proximity proof says: a human is HERE, NOW, CLOSE. That's enough. No fingerprint needed for Gaia. No BLAKE3 needed for Kevin. Proximity bridges the gap.
